The screenshot shows the scripted agent reply; the test stopped at the Bash assertion before its later reply assertions.

unrelatedFailures.scope: The page snapshot showed the mock-llm model selected. This test does not arrange empty LLM settings and stopped before testing icon color. A configured-model precondition mismatch is inferred from the snapshot and test source.

workflowExit.explanation: The wrapper observed the completed-failed marker at 04:50:44 UTC; the runner printed its normal summary at 04:50:45 UTC; the wrapper printed code 124 at 04:50:49 UTC. No runtime kill/hang warning appeared. Its already-running-process branch sleeps five seconds and then unconditionally assigns 124 even if the process exits normally during that grace period. This supports a wrapper exit-code misclassification, not a global deadline or confirmed teardown hang.
